about: Who's older? order facts, hand-kept (design §4.3): pairs whose order a verse states outright. first = the one who came into the world first. kind: stated-age | birth-order | parent | grandparent | generation-gap | created-first. The quote shown is the first span of refs (one or two verses). Parent and grandparent facts are also derived by the build from the family links.
